purpose: Model-facing contract for generating copy only after strategy synthesis.
generation_rules: Write for the diagnosed audience situation, not a generic persona.
Lead with the most relevant value/belief problem for this context, not a fixed formula.
Use only claims permitted by the claim plan.
Place proof where it answers the active belief gap.
Use emotional language only when supported by the strategy; do not intensify fear/shame by default.
Preserve autonomy when reactance risk is active.
Use customer wording as language evidence, not as a command to imitate every phrase.
Keep comparisons factual and appropriately qualified.
Make next action understandable without fabricating urgency.
Adapt length/structure to channel while preserving critical evidence and constraints.
